name: OpenAI Translate
summary: Translate, polish, or run a custom prompt with OpenAI

mode.title: Mode
mode.desc: Translate targets another language; Polish keeps the source language; Custom Prompt uses the templates below

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.desc: Required; create one on the OpenAI API Keys page

baseURL.title: API Base URL
baseURL.desc: Enter the scheme and host without a trailing slash

apiPath.title: Responses API Path
apiPath.desc: Uses OpenAI's recommended Responses API by default

model.title: Model
model.desc: Luna suits high-volume translation; a custom model is also supported

customModel.title: Custom Model
customModel.desc: Used only when Custom model is selected

reasoningEffort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoningEffort.desc: Auto omits the parameter; explicit values must be supported by the selected model

verbosity.title: Text Verbosity
verbosity.desc: Auto omits text.verbosity; some custom models may not support it

maxOutputTokens.title: Max Output Tokens
maxOutputTokens.desc: Responses API max_output_tokens; use a positive integer within the selected model's limit

requestTimeout.title: Request Timeout
requestTimeout.desc: Seconds, within Bob's supported 30–300 second range

systemPrompt.title: System Prompt
systemPrompt.desc: Custom Prompt mode only; supports $query.text, $query.detectFromLang, and $query.detectToLang

userPrompt.title: User Prompt
userPrompt.desc: Custom Prompt mode only; empty input sends the source text
